findings.failure_path: When no recent transcript exists, the script prints `no transcripts under $logs`; `$logs` normally contains absolute home-directory paths. This exposes host details on stdout, directly contradicting the counts/dates-only contract. The regression test requires the leaked `$EMPTY` absolute path, so it falsely validates the violation.
findings.smallest_fix: Emit a path-free sentinel such as `reference_access_census_unevaluated: no transcripts in configured log roots`, and change the test to assert the sentinel while rejecting the absolute log-root path.

challenge_focus: Unprimed adversarial challenge. (1) scripts/reference-access-census.sh reads private agent transcripts: find any branch where a path, prompt text, session id, or host detail reaches stdout or stderr (usage error, unevaluated, partial failure, xargs/grep/find/stat error, unreadable log root, skill name with shell-meta or glob characters, empty --logs entries); any way counts go silently wrong (double count, substring match against another package, mtime edge); any exit path printing the ok token after an error. (2) Relocation batch: enumerate every obligation in the moved SKILL.md bullets at base (six UI/UX, DFE-CONT, tests-before-test-cases, five RMW) and find any obligation, pinned phrase, or pointer the summary bullets or new reference sections drop, weaken, or contradict; check the correction-routing-map table against the verbatim rules. (3) Any borrowed claim in harness 3.1, attention-budget-ratchet, or the IFScale row stated as an invariant its source does not support.

concern_results.conclusion: The relocation text shown is verbatim and its summaries retain the visible obligations; however, the census violates its privacy contract on the no-transcript path. The supplied packet also does not contain primary-source text sufficient to independently validate the borrowed empirical claims.
